def norm(s):
 m=min(r for r,c in s); n=min(c for r,c in s); return sorted((r-m,c-n) for r,c in s)
def ds(s):
 out=[]
 for f in range(8):
  t=[]
  for r,c in s:
   x,y=(r,c)
   if f>=4: y=-y
   for _ in range(f%4): x,y=y,-x
   t.append((x,y))
  out.append(norm(t))
 return out
print([norm(x) for x in shapes]); print(set(map(tuple,map(tuple,ds(shapes[0])))) & set(map(tuple,map(tuple,ds(shapes[1])))))
